sync_products.label: Show products in the till
sync_products.description: Products show up when the Inventory module is installed. Turn it off to sell only services or free-price lines.

sync_services.label: Show services in the till
sync_services.description: Services show up when the Services module is installed. Turn it off to sell only products.

require_customer.label: Require a customer on every sale

max_discount_percent.label: Discount a cashier may give alone (%)
max_discount_percent.description: Above this, the till asks for the manager's PIN and the sale records who authorised it. 100 = no limit.

auto_invoice_with_tax_id.label: Issue an invoice when the customer has a tax ID

receipt_header.label: Receipt header
receipt_header.description: First line = name; the rest = address.

receipt_marketing_url.label: Promotional QR URL
receipt_marketing_url.description: Google reviews, social media, your website… Empty = no promotional QR.

receipt_marketing_text.label: Promotional QR text
receipt_marketing_text.description: For example «Scan and leave us a review».

errors.sales.amount_negative: The sale cannot carry negative amounts.
